name: Parley P. Pratt
dateNote: He was baptized on 1 September 1830, ordained an apostle on 21 February 1835, and killed in Arkansas in 1857.
importance: Section 32 sends him with Oliver Cowdery on the 1830–1831 mission to the Lamanites. Later revelations send him to the Shakers with Sidney Rigdon (49) and to strengthen the churches (50). In Missouri he led the school in Zion approved in section 97. In 1834 he brought news of the Jackson County expulsion to Kirtland, which led to section 103.
connections: He was the older brother of Orson Pratt, whom he baptized. His companions in these sections include Oliver Cowdery, Ziba Peterson, Sidney Rigdon, Joseph Wakefield, and Lyman Wight.

sources.title: Parley Parker Pratt, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 12 Apr. 1807, Burlington, New York; baptized by Oliver Cowdery 1 Sept. 1830; apostle 21 Feb. 1835; jailed in Missouri 1838–1839; returned to Nauvoo 7 Feb. 1843; murdered at Van Buren, Arkansas (death date fragment 13 May 1857). “Parley” alone occurs only in section 49 for him.
